title: 新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園~Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
focus: 橫跨三座獨立擺動塔樓、離地約 200 m 的鋼構平台，及其 66.5 m 懸臂、滑動支承與鋼絞線千斤頂提升~A steel platform about 200 m up across three independently swaying towers: its 66.5 m cantilever, sliding bearings and strand-jack lifting
summary: 濱海灣金沙空中花園是長約 340 m、最寬約 40 m 的鋼構平台，以巨型桁架與鋼箱梁跨越三座 55 層混凝土塔樓，並在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m。課程從三塔相對變位與懸臂人致振動出發，處理鋼箱梁與後拉預力、塔頂 V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承、1,270 t 箱梁以鋼絞線千斤頂提升到約 200 m、塔樓斜腿的施工控制，再談提升監測、阻尼器驗收、無邊際泳池接縫調平與長期徐變維護。~The Marina Bay Sands SkyPark is a steel platform about 340 m long and up to about 40 m wide that bridges three 55-storey concrete towers with mega-trusses and steel box girders and cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower. The course starts from relative tower movement and crowd-induced vibration of the cantilever, then covers box girders and post-tensioning, rooftop V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings, strand-jack lifting of a 1,270 t girder pair to about 200 m and construction control of the leaning tower legs, before turning to lift monitoring, damper acceptance, infinity-pool joints and levelling, and long-term creep and maintenance.

units.anchor: 三塔相對變位~Relative movement of three towers
units.title: 跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台~A platform spanning three independent towers
units.mechanism: 空中花園坐在三座 55 層鋼筋混凝土塔樓頂上，每座塔在風、溫度與混凝土徐變下各自擺動，公開資料指出每座塔可由中心偏移約 250 mm。若把平台與三塔剛接，塔樓的相對位移會在平台中產生巨大附加內力，也會把一座塔的側向力拉到另一座塔。因此平台在各塔頂以斜撐與可滑動支承落座，塔與塔之間的跨段設伸縮接縫，讓每座塔可獨立變位，平台只傳遞重力與必要的水平約束。~The SkyPark sits on three 55-storey reinforced-concrete towers, each swaying on its own under wind, temperature and concrete creep; published accounts state that each tower can move about 250 mm from centre. Rigidly connecting the platform to all three would induce large additional forces in the platform from relative tower movement and pull lateral load from one tower into another. The platform therefore sits on raking struts and sliding bearings at each tower top, with movement joints in the spans between towers, so that each tower moves independently and the platform transfers gravity and only the necessary horizontal restraint.
units.model: 兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。另計鋼平台本身溫度變形：α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、L = 340 m、ΔT = 20°C，ΔL = αLΔT ≈ 82 mm。接縫與支承須同時容納兩者。溫差與兩塔反相假設為教學假設。~If two adjacent towers sway in opposite directions by 250 mm each, the relative movement at the joint is at most about 250 + 250 = 500 mm. The steel platform's own thermal movement adds ΔL = αLΔT ≈ 82 mm for α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, L = 340 m and ΔT = 20°C. Joints and bearings must accommodate both. The temperature range and out-of-phase sway are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以整體模型組合三塔在風、溫度與長期徐變下的位移時程，計算每個接縫與支承的最大開合量與轉角，並與支承及接縫的設計行程比較；確認在支承摩擦與最不利組合下，平台不會把一座塔的水平力大量傳到另一座塔。~Combine the three towers' displacement histories under wind, temperature and long-term creep in a global model, compute the maximum opening, closing and rotation at each joint and bearing, and compare with their design travel; confirm that, under bearing friction and the worst combination, the platform does not transfer significant horizontal force from one tower to another.
units.failure: 若接縫行程只按溫度設計而忽略塔樓反向擺動與徐變，強風時接縫頂死，平台受壓挫屈或把支承螺栓剪斷；反之若接縫過鬆而無止擋，極端風況下平台可能從支承滑脫。~Sizing joint travel only for temperature and ignoring opposite tower sway and creep lets joints close solid in strong wind, buckling the platform in compression or shearing bearing bolts; conversely, over-generous joints without stops could let the platform slide off its bearings in extreme wind.
units.misconception: 三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。~All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest.
units.practice: 接縫與支承的設計行程要列出各分量（風、溫度、徐變、施工誤差）與組合方式，並在圖說上標示每個支承的約束方向；任何後續在平台上增設的固定物都不得跨越接縫。~State the design travel of joints and bearings by component (wind, temperature, creep, construction tolerance) and combination method, and mark the restrained directions of each bearing on the drawings; nothing added to the platform later may bridge across a joint.

units.anchor: 66.5 m 懸臂端~66.5 m cantilever tip
units.title: 懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動~Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration
units.mechanism: 平台在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m，由一對約 80 m 長的鋼箱梁構成，是遊客聚集觀景的位置。長懸臂勁度有限，靜載撓度大時，其豎向自然頻率會落入人行（約 1.6 至 2.4 Hz）或跳躍、跑動的激振範圍，群眾同步活動可能引起明顯振動。設計除了以預拱抵消自重撓度，還在懸臂端的腹部內藏一組約 4.5 t 的調諧質量阻尼器，專門處理人群活動引起的振動。~The platform cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower on a pair of steel box girders about 80 m long, the spot where visitors gather for the view. A long cantilever has limited stiffness; when its static deflection is large, its vertical natural frequency falls into the range excited by walking (about 1.6 to 2.4 Hz) or by jumping and running, and synchronised crowd activity can produce noticeable vibration. Besides pre-cambering against self-weight deflection, the design hides a tuned mass damper of about 4.5 t in the belly of the cantilever tip specifically for crowd-induced vibration.
units.model: 以單自由度粗估 f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ)，δ 為等效靜撓度。若 δ = 60 mm，f = (1/2π)·√(9.81/0.06) ≈ 2.0 Hz，正落在步行頻率範圍；若加大勁度使 δ = 30 mm，f ≈ 2.9 Hz，已高於多數步行頻率，但仍可能被跳躍激發。撓度值為教學假設。~A single-degree-of-freedom estimate gives f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ) with δ the equivalent static deflection. With δ = 60 mm, f = (1/2π)·√(9.81/0.06) ≈ 2.0 Hz, right in the walking range; stiffening to δ = 30 mm gives f ≈ 2.9 Hz, above most walking frequencies but still excitable by jumping. The deflections are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以有限元素模型求懸臂的豎向與扭轉模態，並以人群荷載模型（步行、跑動、跳躍）做時程分析，預測尖峰加速度；完工後以加速度計量測環境振動與人群試驗，確認頻率與阻尼和預測相符，加速度低於設計舒適度門檻。~Compute vertical and torsional modes of the cantilever with a finite-element model and run time-history analyses with crowd load models for walking, running and jumping to predict peak acceleration; after completion measure ambient vibration and crowd tests with accelerometers to confirm that frequency and damping match prediction and accelerations stay below the design comfort limit.
units.failure: 若只檢核強度與靜撓度，懸臂可能在活動或派對時被群眾同步跳動激起共振，地板明顯晃動引起恐慌；倫敦千禧橋 2000 年開放時的側向晃動，就是人行激振被低估的著名例子。~Checking only strength and static deflection can leave a cantilever that resonates when a crowd jumps in time at an event, the floor visibly bouncing and causing alarm; the lateral sway of London's Millennium Bridge on opening in 2000 is a famous case of underestimated pedestrian excitation.
units.misconception: 鋼結構懸臂只要撓度在規範限值內，人走在上面就不會感到振動。~If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration.
units.practice: 觀景平台與懸臂的設計基準應明列人群活動情境、使用人數與加速度限值，並預留阻尼器的安裝空間與檢修通道；營運單位舉辦大型活動前，須依結構顧問提供的人數與活動類型限制核准。~The design basis of viewing platforms and cantilevers should list crowd scenarios, occupancy and acceleration limits and reserve space and access for dampers; before large events the operator must approve them against the occupancy and activity limits given by the structural consultant.

units.anchor: 10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁~10 m deep post-tensioned box girders
units.title: 鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力~Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning
units.mechanism: 平台的主承重構件是約 10 m 深、3.7 m 寬的鋼箱梁，公開資料記載側壁厚約 35 mm、翼板約 60 mm，並配合後拉預力。深箱梁以高抗彎與抗扭勁度承擔長跨與懸臂，封閉斷面也讓偏心的人群與風荷載不致造成過大扭轉。後拉預力可以在吊裝完成後調整箱梁內力與撓度，抵消部分自重造成的上翼板拉力。跨越塔與塔之間的區段則由每段三榀約 400 噸的巨型桁架組成。~The platform's main members are steel box girders about 10 m deep and 3.7 m wide; published data give side walls about 35 mm and flanges about 60 mm thick, combined with post-tensioning. Deep boxes carry the long spans and cantilever with high bending and torsional stiffness, and the closed section keeps eccentric crowd and wind loads from causing excessive twist. Post-tensioning lets engineers adjust girder forces and deflection after erection, offsetting part of the top-flange tension from self-weight. The spans between towers use three mega-trusses of about 400 tons in each bridging section.
units.model: 單根箱梁慣性矩 I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴，斷面模數 Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³。若懸臂兩根箱梁共承受 w = 120 kN/m，根部彎矩 M = wL²/2 = 120×66.5²/2 ≈ 265,000 kN·m，每根 132,700 kN·m，翼板應力 σ = M/Z ≈ 39.5 MPa。荷載為教學假設。~One box girder has I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴ and Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³. If the two cantilever girders together carry w = 120 kN/m, the root moment is M = wL²/2 = 120×66.5²/2 ≈ 265,000 kN·m, 132,700 kN·m per girder, giving a flange stress σ = M/Z ≈ 39.5 MPa. The load is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 鋼板依厚度與部位做材質證明、超音波夾層檢查與焊縫非破壞檢測；預力張拉以壓力與伸長雙控，並在張拉前後量測懸臂端標高，確認預拱與撓度變化符合計算；箱梁內部設置檢修通道與除濕或通風，交接前檢查內部塗裝。~Check plates by mill certificate, ultrasonic lamination testing and weld non-destructive testing according to thickness and location; control post-tensioning by pressure and elongation, and survey the cantilever tip level before and after stressing to confirm that camber and deflection change match calculation; provide internal access and dehumidification or ventilation in the boxes and inspect internal coatings before handover.
units.failure: 高空箱梁焊接若在風雨中施作而沒有遮蔽，預熱不足會造成氫致裂紋；預力錨具附近的局部承壓區加勁不足，張拉時腹板局部挫屈。箱梁內部若無通風檢修，熱帶潮濕空氣凝結，內壁腐蝕長年不被發現。~Welding box girders at height in wind and rain without shelter risks hydrogen cracking from inadequate preheat; insufficient stiffening of the local bearing zone at post-tensioning anchorages can buckle the web during stressing. Without ventilation and access inside the boxes, condensation from humid tropical air corrodes inner walls unnoticed for years.
units.misconception: 鋼箱梁是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕也不需要檢查。~A steel box girder is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection.
units.practice: 箱梁圖說應標示人孔、檢修步道、通風或除濕設備與排水孔位置；後拉預力的錨具應設計為可檢查、必要時可重新張拉，張拉紀錄與標高量測一起歸檔。~Box-girder drawings should show manholes, inspection walkways, ventilation or dehumidification and drain holes; post-tensioning anchorages should be inspectable and re-stressable if needed, with stressing records filed together with level surveys.

units.anchor: V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承~V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings
units.title: 塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部~Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details
units.mechanism: 平台跨越各塔的區段以傾斜的鋼 V 形斜撐落在塔頂剪力牆上方，把重力集中傳入塔樓核心牆。在塔與塔之間的跨段端部，使用鋁板與不鏽鋼滑板組成的多向支承，讓平台能相對塔樓自由滑動與轉動，同時傳遞豎向反力。滑動面的摩擦係數決定了塔樓擺動時傳入平台的水平力，因此支承材料、表面光潔度與防塵防水細部，直接影響平台的受力。~Where the platform passes over each tower it lands on raking steel V-struts above the tower's shear walls, concentrating gravity into the core walls. At the ends of the spans between towers, multidirectional bearings with aluminium and stainless-steel sliding plates let the platform slide and rotate relative to the towers while carrying vertical reactions. The friction coefficient of the sliding surfaces sets the horizontal force fed into the platform when towers sway, so bearing materials, surface finish and dust and water protection directly affect platform forces.
units.model: 支承豎向反力 N = 10,000 kN，滑動面摩擦係數 μ = 0.03 時，水平摩擦力 F = μN = 300 kN；若滑動面因污染或腐蝕卡滯使 μ 升到 0.2，F = 2,000 kN，約為原值的 6.7 倍，會以設計外的水平力推動平台與斜撐。反力與摩擦係數為教學假設。~With a vertical bearing reaction N = 10,000 kN and a sliding-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.03, the horizontal friction force is F = μN = 300 kN; if contamination or corrosion makes the surface stick with μ = 0.2, F = 2,000 kN, about 6.7 times larger, pushing the platform and struts with horizontal force outside the design. Reaction and friction coefficients are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 支承出廠前做摩擦係數、豎向承載與轉角試驗，與規格比較；安裝時量測支承水平度、預設偏移量與當時溫度，確認滑板中心位置符合安裝溫度下的設計值；使用期間定期量測支承滑移量並檢查防塵罩與排水。~Before delivery test bearings for friction coefficient, vertical capacity and rotation against the specification; at installation survey bearing levelness, preset offset and ambient temperature to confirm the sliding plate is centred for the installation temperature; in service measure bearing travel periodically and inspect dust covers and drainage.
units.failure: 安裝時未依溫度設定預設偏移，滑板一側行程不足，塔樓擺動或高溫時支承頂到端部止擋；滑動面積水、鹽分與灰塵造成磨損或腐蝕，摩擦升高後平台與斜撐承受設計外的水平力。~Without a temperature-based preset offset at installation, one side of the sliding plate runs out of travel and the bearing hits its end stop when towers sway or it gets hot; water, salt and dust on the sliding surface cause wear or corrosion, and the raised friction subjects platform and struts to unplanned horizontal force.
units.misconception: 滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。~Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance.
units.practice: 每個支承應有標示牌與行程刻度，安裝紀錄記下溫度與偏移；維護計畫列明清潔、檢查與更換週期，支承更換所需的頂升點與臨時支撐在設計階段就要預留。~Each bearing should have a tag and a travel scale, with installation records stating temperature and offset; the maintenance plan should list cleaning, inspection and replacement intervals, and jacking points and temporary supports needed for bearing replacement should be provided at design stage.

units.anchor: 1,270 t 箱梁整體提升~1,270 t girder lift
units.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空~Strand-jack lifting to 200 m
units.mechanism: 平台在地面或低處分成 14 個主要預製段，再以鋼絞線千斤頂吊上塔頂；最大一次提升是構成懸臂的一對約 80 m 長箱梁，重約 1,270 t，提升速度約每小時 14 m，耗時超過 16 小時。鋼絞線千斤頂以上下夾片交替夾持鋼絞線，像爬繩一樣一個行程一個行程地拉升重物，多台千斤頂由電腦同步控制。懸臂段另以可移動的門架安裝。整個工程用了約 4,000 t 臨時鋼結構，約為永久鋼結構 7,000 t 的一半以上。~The platform was prefabricated in 14 main segments and raised to the tower tops by strand jacks; the largest lift was the pair of box girders about 80 m long that form the cantilever, weighing about 1,270 t, raised at about 14 m per hour over more than 16 hours. A strand jack grips the strands alternately with upper and lower wedge anchors and climbs them stroke by stroke like a rope climber, with several jacks synchronised by computer. Cantilever segments were also placed with a movable gantry. The job used about 4,000 t of temporary steelwork, more than half of the 7,000 t of permanent steel.
units.model: 提升重量 1,270 t，F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN。若每根 15.7 mm 鋼絞線最小破斷力 279 kN、要求安全係數 2.5，需 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 根鋼絞線，分配到 4 台千斤頂每台約 28 根。提升 200 m、速度 14 m/h，純提升時間約 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h，加上停檢與對位即超過 16 小時。鋼絞線規格與安全係數為教學假設。~The lift of 1,270 t is F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN. With 15.7 mm strands of 279 kN minimum breaking load and a required safety factor of 2.5, about 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 strands are needed, about 28 per jack for 4 jacks. Lifting 200 m at 14 m/h takes about 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h of pure lifting, exceeding 16 hours with hold checks and final alignment. Strand size and safety factor are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 提升前完成千斤頂、鋼絞線、錨具與塔頂臨時提升架的設計核算與荷載試驗，並做離地試吊（提升數百毫米後停留觀察）；提升中監測各千斤頂荷載、行程與重物水平度，並記錄風速；到位後先臨時固定，經測量確認位置後才連接永久支承。~Before lifting, complete design checks and load tests of jacks, strands, anchors and the temporary lifting frames on the tower tops, and do a trial lift that raises the load a few hundred millimetres and holds it for observation; during the lift monitor each jack's load, stroke and the levelness of the load and record wind speed; on arrival fix temporarily and connect to permanent bearings only after survey confirms position.
units.failure: 千斤頂不同步會使重物傾斜，荷載集中到少數鋼絞線與吊點，可能拉壞吊耳或局部屈曲箱梁；提升途中風速升高使重物擺動撞擊塔樓。臨時提升架若未考慮提升時的水平分力，可能在重物離地瞬間失穩。~Unsynchronised jacks tilt the load and concentrate it on a few strands and lifting points, which may tear a lug or locally buckle the girder; rising wind during the lift swings the load into the tower. A temporary lifting frame that ignores horizontal components during lifting may lose stability just as the load leaves the ground.
units.misconception: 鋼絞線千斤頂提升只要總吊重小於千斤頂容量就安全。~Strand-jack lifting is safe as long as the total weight is below the jacks' combined capacity.
units.practice: 提升作業須有完整的提升計畫：荷載分配、同步容許差、風速上限、試吊程序、緊急停止與錨固措施，並由提升專業承包商、結構設計者與業主代表簽認；本課只說明檢核邏輯，實際操作須由合格人員依核准程序執行。~A lift needs a complete lifting plan with load distribution, synchronisation tolerance, wind limit, trial-lift procedure, emergency stop and anchoring measures, signed by the specialist lifting contractor, the structural designer and the owner's representative; this course explains the checking logic only, and actual operation must be performed by qualified personnel under an approved procedure.

units.anchor: 塔樓斜腿與臨時拉桿~Leaning tower legs and ties
units.title: 斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制~Construction-stage control of the leaning towers
units.mechanism: 每座旅館塔樓由兩支不對稱的腿組成，彎曲的東腿向另一支腿傾靠，兩腿在第 23 層以層高鋼桁架連結。施工期間斜腿在連結前無法自立，因此以臨時鋼支撐頂住，並以高強度鋼腱拉住；這些鋼腱原規劃為臨時，最後保留為永久。地面層以後拉預力基礎版承受斜腿產生的水平推力，並以預拱抵消自重造成的側向位移。Arup 預估塔樓的側向變形會持續約 30 年才趨於穩定。~Each hotel tower has two asymmetric legs, the curved east leg leaning against the other, connected at Level 23 by storey-high steel trusses. Before connection the inclined leg cannot stand alone, so it was propped by temporary steel struts and tied with high-tensile tendons, which were planned as temporary but finally kept as permanent. A post-tensioned slab at ground level resists the horizontal thrust from the inclined legs, and pre-camber offsets lateral displacement from self-weight. Arup expected the towers to keep deforming laterally for about 30 years before the movements converge.
units.model: 斜腿軸力 N = 200 MN、傾角 θ = 20° 時，水平推力 H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN。若以 15.7 mm 鋼絞線、每根工作力 0.6×279 ≈ 167 kN 承擔，需約 72,800/167 ≈ 436 根；若傾角增為 25°，H ≈ 93.3 MN，需約 559 根。軸力與傾角為教學假設。~With a leg axial force N = 200 MN at an inclination θ = 20°, the horizontal thrust is H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN. Carried by 15.7 mm strands at a working force of 0.6×279 ≈ 167 kN each, about 72,800/167 ≈ 436 strands are needed; at 25°, H ≈ 93.3 MN and about 559 strands. Axial force and angle are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每升高數層就量測斜腿與核心牆的實際座標，與施工階段分析（含徐變、收縮與預拱）比較；監測臨時拉桿與支撐的受力，確認在連結桁架完成前不超過設計值；連結後與卸除臨時支撐時再量測一次，作為塔頂平台安裝的基準。~Every few floors survey the actual coordinates of the inclined legs and core walls and compare with the construction-stage analysis including creep, shrinkage and pre-camber; monitor forces in temporary ties and props to confirm they stay within design before the connecting trusses are complete; survey again after connection and when temporary props are removed, as the baseline for installing the rooftop platform.
units.failure: 若預拱只按彈性變形設定而忽略徐變，塔樓完工多年後仍持續側移，塔頂支承與泳池接縫的行程被逐漸吃掉；臨時拉桿若在連結桁架完成前提早放鬆，斜腿可能出現過大彎矩與裂縫。~Setting pre-camber for elastic deformation only and ignoring creep lets the towers keep drifting years after completion, gradually using up the travel of rooftop bearings and pool joints; releasing temporary ties before the connecting trusses are complete can overload the inclined leg in bending and crack it.
units.misconception: 混凝土塔樓完工後變形就停止，平台可以按完工量測位置一次固定。~A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position.
units.practice: 斜腿結構的施工階段分析要列入施工計畫的附件，每一個臨時拉桿與支撐的安裝、張拉與拆除都是停止點，須經結構設計者確認量測結果後才能進行下一步。~The construction-stage analysis of inclined legs belongs in the construction-plan appendices, and installing, stressing and removing each temporary tie or prop is a hold point that proceeds only after the structural designer confirms the survey results.

units.anchor: 提升同步與風速監測~Lift synchronisation and wind monitoring
units.title: 提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測~Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts
units.mechanism: 鋼絞線提升是一連串短行程的累積，每個行程都可能讓各千斤頂出現微小高差；高差累積後重物傾斜，荷載重新分配。80 m 長的箱梁在高空懸吊時也像一面大風帆，橫向風力使重物擺動並在鋼絞線中產生不均勻張力。因此提升系統必須同時監測每台千斤頂的荷載與行程、重物兩端的高程差，以及現場與高空的風速，並以預先約定的門檻決定繼續、暫停或下降。~Strand lifting is a sequence of short strokes, each of which can leave tiny level differences between jacks; accumulated, they tilt the load and redistribute force. An 80 m girder hanging at height also acts like a large sail, so lateral wind makes it swing and loads the strands unevenly. The lifting system must therefore monitor each jack's load and stroke, the level difference between the ends of the load and wind speed at ground and at height, deciding to continue, pause or lower against thresholds agreed in advance.
units.model: 80 m 箱梁兩端高差 50 mm，轉角 θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°，看似很小，但在剛性重物上會讓高端吊點荷載明顯增加。風速 15 m/s 時 q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×15² ≈ 138 Pa，迎風面 80 m × 10 m = 800 m²、阻力係數 2.0，橫向力 F ≈ 138×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN。風速與阻力係數為教學假設。~A 50 mm level difference over an 80 m girder is a rotation θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°, small in appearance but enough to raise the load on the high-end lifting points of a stiff load noticeably. At 15 m/s wind, q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×15² ≈ 138 Pa; with a frontal area of 80 m × 10 m = 800 m² and drag coefficient 2.0, the lateral force is F ≈ 138×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN. Wind speed and drag coefficient are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 提升前校正每台千斤頂的壓力感測器與行程計，並以試吊確認荷載分配與計算相符；提升中以自動系統記錄荷載、行程與高差，超過門檻自動停止；設置地面與高空風速計，並取得氣象預報，決定提升時窗。~Before lifting, calibrate each jack's pressure sensor and stroke transducer and confirm the load distribution against calculation by a trial lift; during lifting record load, stroke and level difference automatically with automatic stop at thresholds; install anemometers at ground and at height and use weather forecasts to choose the lifting window.
units.failure: 只監測千斤頂壓力而不量測重物高差，壓力感測器漂移時可能誤判同步；在午後雷雨前開始提升，突陣風讓懸吊箱梁擺盪撞擊塔樓立面或臨時架，造成構件與結構損傷。~Monitoring only jack pressure without measuring the load's level difference can misjudge synchronisation when a sensor drifts; starting a lift before an afternoon thunderstorm lets a sudden gust swing the hanging girder into the tower façade or temporary frames, damaging both.
units.misconception: 千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。~If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded.
units.practice: 提升監測的門檻（荷載偏差、高差、風速）與處置流程須在提升計畫中寫明，並指定唯一的提升指揮與停止權責；熱帶地區要把雷雨季節與每日氣象變化納入時程。~Thresholds for load deviation, level difference and wind speed, with the response procedure, must be written into the lifting plan, naming a single lift commander with clear stop authority; in the tropics, thunderstorm seasons and daily weather patterns must be built into the schedule.

units.anchor: 4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器~4.5 t tuned mass damper
units.title: 人群振動試驗與阻尼器驗收~Crowd-vibration tests and damper acceptance
units.mechanism: 懸臂端的阻尼器是否有效，要在完工後以實測證明：先量環境振動求懸臂實際頻率與阻尼，再以有組織的人群步行、跑動或跳躍試驗，量測加速度並與舒適度限值比較。阻尼器必須調整到實際頻率，鎖定與釋放阻尼器各量一次可以直接看出它提供的附加阻尼。對觀景平台而言，豎向與扭轉模態都可能被偏心人群激發，量測點需包含懸臂端兩側。~Whether the damper at the cantilever tip works must be proven by measurement after completion: first ambient vibration to identify the cantilever's actual frequency and damping, then organised crowd walking, running or jumping tests to measure acceleration against comfort limits. The damper must be tuned to the measured frequency, and measuring once with it locked and once released shows directly the added damping it provides. On a viewing deck both vertical and torsional modes can be excited by eccentric crowds, so measurement points must include both sides of the tip.
units.model: 簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·x。若懸臂頻率 f = 2.0 Hz、人群試驗中振幅 x = 3 mm，a = (2π×2.0)²×0.003 ≈ 0.47 m/s²；若阻尼器使振幅降為 1.5 mm，a ≈ 0.24 m/s²。頻率與振幅為教學假設。~For harmonic motion, a = (2πf)²·x. With a cantilever frequency f = 2.0 Hz and a 3 mm amplitude in a crowd test, a = (2π×2.0)²×0.003 ≈ 0.47 m/s²; if the damper halves the amplitude to 1.5 mm, a ≈ 0.24 m/s². Frequency and amplitudes are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫寫明人數、步頻（以節拍器控制）、活動類型與量測點，重複三次取平均；比較鎖定與釋放阻尼器的頻率響應與尖峰加速度，確認附加阻尼達到設計要求，並把結果與 ISO 10137 等使用性準則比較。~The test plan should state the number of people, pacing frequency controlled by metronome, activity type and measurement points, repeating three times for an average; compare frequency response and peak acceleration with the damper locked and released to confirm the added damping meets the design requirement, and check the results against serviceability criteria such as ISO 10137.
units.failure: 阻尼器依設計頻率出廠但未現場調頻，實際頻率偏離後效果大減；試驗只做少數人步行，未涵蓋大型活動的同步跳躍，營運後在派對或活動時才發現明顯晃動。~A damper shipped to the design frequency and not tuned on site loses much of its effect when the real frequency differs; tests with only a few walkers that omit synchronised jumping at large events reveal noticeable bouncing only after opening, at a party or event.
units.misconception: 阻尼器裝好就一定有效，不需要做人群試驗。~Once a damper is installed it is certainly effective, so no crowd test is needed.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含阻尼器的調頻紀錄、鎖定與釋放試驗結果、可承受的人數與活動類型限制，以及阻尼器檢修週期；平台活動規劃須由營運單位依這些限制審核。~Handover should include the damper's tuning record, locked and released test results, permitted occupancy and activity limits and its maintenance interval; the operator must review event plans on the platform against these limits.

units.anchor: 泳池接縫與調平千斤頂~Pool joints and levelling jacks
units.title: 無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷~Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement
units.mechanism: 約 150 m 長的無邊際泳池由三個約 50 m 的不鏽鋼池體組成，以水下伸縮接縫連成一體，跨越塔與塔之間的變位；池體下方以可調鋼千斤頂支承，在建築沉陷與變形後仍能調平。無邊際池緣要求整條溢流堰保持近乎水平，幾毫米的高差就會讓水集中從低處溢流，高處則乾涸露出堰頂。泳池同時是平台上最大的活荷載之一，滿水重量必須納入支承與箱梁設計。~The infinity pool, about 150 m long, consists of three stainless-steel tanks of about 50 m joined by underwater movement joints that cross the movements between towers; adjustable steel jacks beneath the tanks allow re-levelling after building settlement and deformation. An infinity edge requires the whole weir to stay almost perfectly level: a few millimetres of difference make water spill mostly at the low point while the high part runs dry and exposes the weir. The pool is also one of the largest loads on the platform, and its full water weight must be included in bearing and girder design.
units.model: 堰流單寬流量 q = 1.84·h^1.5（m³/s/m）。堰上水頭 h = 5 mm 時 q ≈ 1.84×0.005^1.5 ≈ 0.65 L/s/m，146 m 堰全長約 95 L/s；若一端下沉 5 mm 使該端水頭變 10 mm，q ≈ 1.84 L/s/m，約為原值 2.8 倍，而另一端水頭趨近 0、堰頂乾涸。水頭與沉陷量為教學假設。~Weir discharge per metre q = 1.84·h^1.5 in m³/s/m. With a head h = 5 mm, q ≈ 1.84×0.005^1.5 ≈ 0.65 L/s/m, about 95 L/s along a 146 m weir; if one end settles 5 mm so its head becomes 10 mm, q ≈ 1.84 L/s/m there, about 2.8 times larger, while the head at the other end approaches 0 and the weir runs dry. Head and settlement are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以精密水準或液面量測沿溢流堰每隔數公尺量高程，與允許高差比較；水下接縫做灌水試驗與滲漏監測，並在塔樓擺動、溫度變化期間檢查接縫開合；調平千斤頂每次調整都記錄位置、調整量與當時溫度。~Survey the weir level every few metres by precise levelling or water-surface measurement and compare with the allowable difference; flood-test the underwater joints and monitor leakage, checking joint opening and closing during tower sway and temperature change; record the position, adjustment and temperature at every levelling-jack adjustment.
units.failure: 接縫行程不足或密封老化，池水滲入鋼平台與箱梁，造成腐蝕與下方樓層漏水；長期徐變沉陷未定期調平，溢流不均使部分堰頂乾涸，水流集中處沖刷與噴濺，影響營運與安全。~Joints with insufficient travel or aged seals let pool water into the steel platform and girders, causing corrosion and leaks to floors below; without periodic re-levelling for long-term creep settlement, uneven overflow dries parts of the weir while concentrated flow erodes and splashes elsewhere, affecting operation and safety.
units.misconception: 泳池只是建築設施，與平台結構設計無關。~The pool is only an amenity and has nothing to do with platform structural design.
units.practice: 泳池的調平紀錄、接縫行程監測與防水檢查應與結構監測整合在同一資料系統，任何排水或清池作業都要通知結構顧問，避免荷載快速變化造成支承與箱梁不預期的反應。~Pool levelling records, joint-travel monitoring and waterproofing inspections should share one data system with structural monitoring, and any draining or refilling must be notified to the structural consultant to avoid unexpected bearing and girder response to rapid load change.

units.anchor: 長期徐變與支承紀錄~Long-term creep and bearing records
units.title: 塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接~Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover
units.mechanism: 混凝土塔樓的徐變與收縮使側向變形持續多年，公開資料估計約 30 年才趨於穩定，因此平台支承、伸縮接縫與泳池調平都是長期運作的系統，而不是一次性安裝。熱帶海濱環境高溫、高濕與鹽霧，對鋼平台塗裝、滑動支承與泳池不鏽鋼都是考驗。交接文件必須記錄每個支承的初始偏移與行程、預力與調平紀錄、阻尼器參數與監測基準，讓營運者能判斷何時需要調整或更換。~Creep and shrinkage keep the concrete towers deforming laterally for years, about 30 years before converging according to the published account, so platform bearings, movement joints and pool levelling are long-running systems rather than one-off installations. The hot, humid, salty tropical waterfront tests the steel platform's coatings, the sliding bearings and the pool's stainless steel. Handover documents must record each bearing's initial offset and travel, prestress and levelling records, damper parameters and monitoring baselines, so the operator can tell when adjustment or replacement is needed.
units.model: 以指數曲線描述徐變側移 δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ))。取 δ∞ = 60 mm、τ = 8 年：第 10 年 δ ≈ 60×(1 − e^(−1.25)) ≈ 42.8 mm，第 30 年 δ ≈ 58.6 mm，剩餘不到 2 mm；若只預留 40 mm 行程，約第 9 年就會用完。δ∞ 與 τ 為教學假設。~Describe creep drift with an exponential curve δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ)). With δ∞ = 60 mm and τ = 8 years, δ ≈ 60×(1 − e^(−1.25)) ≈ 42.8 mm at year 10 and δ ≈ 58.6 mm at year 30, less than 2 mm remaining; if only 40 mm of travel were provided it would be used up around year 9. δ∞ and τ are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每年在固定季節與時段量測塔頂座標、支承滑移量與接縫開度，與預測曲線比較並外推剩餘行程；每次大雷暴或強風後檢查支承、接縫與泳池水平；塗裝依區域做膜厚與鏽蝕評等。~Survey tower-top coordinates, bearing travel and joint openings every year at a fixed season and time of day, compare with the predicted curve and extrapolate remaining travel; inspect bearings, joints and pool level after every severe thunderstorm or strong wind; rate coatings by zone for film thickness and rust.
units.failure: 沒有初始偏移紀錄，營運者無法判斷支承目前用掉多少行程，直到支承頂到止擋、出現異音或接縫損壞才發現；塗裝破損未及時修補，高濕環境使鋼平台邊緣與排水處快速腐蝕。~Without records of initial offsets, the operator cannot tell how much bearing travel has been used until a bearing hits its stop, makes noise or a joint is damaged; coating damage left unrepaired lets platform edges and drainage points corrode quickly in the humid climate.
units.misconception: 平台完工驗收合格後，只需要清潔與美化維護。~Once the platform passes completion acceptance it only needs cleaning and cosmetic upkeep.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含支承與接縫的初始偏移與行程表、徐變預測曲線、提升與預力紀錄、阻尼器調頻紀錄、泳池調平紀錄與監測資料格式；任何在平台上增加重量或改變用途的計畫，須先由結構顧問評估再核准。~Handover should include initial offset and travel tables for bearings and joints, the creep prediction curve, lifting and prestressing records, damper tuning records, pool levelling records and the monitoring data format; any plan that adds weight to the platform or changes its use must be assessed by the structural consultant before approval.

example: 設計練習：估算懸臂箱梁提升所需的鋼絞線數與提升時間。提升件為一對約 80 m 長的箱梁，假設重 1,270 t，F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN。選用 15.7 mm 鋼絞線，最小破斷力 279 kN，要求安全係數 2.5：所需根數 n = 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 根，以 4 台千斤頂分配每台 28 根。提升高度 200 m、速度 14 m/h，純提升時間 t = 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h。若高空風速 15 m/s，箱梁迎風面 80 m × 10 m、阻力係數 2.0，橫向風力約 0.5×1.225×15²×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN，約為吊重的 1.8%，鋼絞線偏角約 atan(220/12,460) ≈ 1.0°。若安全係數改為 3.0，需約 134 根，每台 34 根；若風速增為 20 m/s，風力約 392 kN，偏角約 1.8°。所有數值為教學假設，不代表濱海灣金沙的實際提升設計。~Design exercise: estimate the strands and lifting time for the cantilever box-girder lift. The load is a pair of box girders about 80 m long, assumed to weigh 1,270 t, F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN. Using 15.7 mm strand with a 279 kN minimum breaking load and a safety factor of 2.5, the number of strands is n = 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112, or 28 per jack for 4 jacks. Lifting 200 m at 14 m/h takes t = 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h of pure lifting. At a wind speed of 15 m/s at height, with an 80 m × 10 m frontal area and drag coefficient 2.0, the lateral force is about 0.5×1.225×15²×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN, about 1.8% of the weight, giving a strand inclination of about atan(220/12,460) ≈ 1.0°. A safety factor of 3.0 needs about 134 strands, 34 per jack; a 20 m/s wind gives about 392 kN and an inclination of about 1.8°. All values are teaching assumptions, not the actual lifting design at Marina Bay Sands.
history: 濱海灣金沙綜合度假村由 Moshe Safdie 設計，Arup 擔任結構顧問，雙龍建設（Ssangyong E&C）承建，2006 年設計競圖後約四年即接近完工。三座 55 層旅館塔樓以斜靠的雙腿與第 23 層鋼桁架連結，塔頂的空中花園長約 340 m，以巨型桁架與鋼箱梁跨越三塔並懸挑約 66.5 m；平台分成 14 個主要預製段，由 VSL 以鋼絞線千斤頂提升到約 200 m 高空，懸臂端內藏調諧質量阻尼器處理人群振動。空中花園於 2010 年 6 月開放。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The Marina Bay Sands integrated resort was designed by Moshe Safdie with Arup as structural engineer and built by Ssangyong E&C, reaching substantial completion about four years after the 2006 design competition. Its three 55-storey hotel towers have leaning twin legs connected by steel trusses at Level 23, and the SkyPark on top, about 340 m long, bridges the towers with mega-trusses and steel box girders and cantilevers about 66.5 m; the platform was prefabricated in 14 main segments and strand-jacked to about 200 m by VSL, with a tuned mass damper hidden in the cantilever tip against crowd vibration. The SkyPark opened in June 2010. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 空中花園全長約 340 m、最寬約 40 m，面積約 1.2 公頃~The SkyPark is about 340 m long and up to about 40 m wide, covering about 1.2 ha
平台在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m，距海平面約 200 m~The platform cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower, about 200 m above sea level
三座旅館塔樓各 55 層，建築頂高約 207 m~The three hotel towers have 55 storeys each, with an architectural top of about 207 m
平台分成 14 個主要預製鋼段，以鋼絞線千斤頂提升~The platform was prefabricated in 14 main steel segments and raised by strand jacks
最大一次提升為一對約 80 m 長、約 1,270 t 的箱梁，提升速度約 14 m/h，耗時超過 16 小時~The largest lift was a pair of box girders about 80 m long and about 1,270 t, raised at about 14 m/h over more than 16 hours
永久鋼結構約 7,000 t，臨時鋼結構約 4,000 t~Permanent steelwork was about 7,000 t and temporary steelwork about 4,000 t
懸臂端內藏約 4.5 t 的調諧質量阻尼器，處理人群活動振動~A tuned mass damper of about 4.5 t in the cantilever tip controls crowd-induced vibration
每座塔可由中心擺動約 250 mm，平台以多向滑動支承容許獨立變位~Each tower can sway about 250 mm from centre, and multidirectional sliding bearings let the platform accommodate it
基礎採約 1.5 m 厚、深約 50 m 的連續壁，形成直徑可達約 120 m 的圍堰~Foundations use diaphragm walls about 1.5 m thick and about 50 m deep forming cofferdams up to about 120 m in diameter
